tools.title: Image Compressor
tools.desc: Compress JPG, PNG and WebP images in your browser with adjustable quality. Nothing is uploaded.
tools.intro: Perfect for saving storage or speeding up web pages - you can compare the compressed result against the original before downloading.

faq.a: No. The file is read with the browser's canvas API and processed entirely on your device — nothing is sent to any server.

faq.q: Why is my PNG sometimes bigger than the original?
faq.a: PNG is a lossless format, so re-encoding a JPEG-style photo as PNG can increase the size. For photos, use JPEG or WebP output to actually save space.

tools.title: Image Converter
tools.desc: Convert images between PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP and GIF with no uploads.
tools.intro: Batch-friendly and instant: pick your target format, tweak quality where available, then export directly from the browser.

faq.q: Which formats can I convert between?
faq.a: PNG, JPG, WEBP and BMP. Converting to JPEG or BMP flattens transparency onto a white background; PNG and WEBP preserve it.

faq.q: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a: No hard limit, but very large images are scaled down to at most 4000px on the longest side to keep your browser responsive.

tools.title: Image Resizer
tools.desc: Resize a picture to any width or height, keep or override the aspect ratio, and download instantly.
tools.intro: Great for social media images, thumbnails and website assets where exact pixel dimensions matter.

faq.a: No, by default. Turn on "Allow upscaling" if you want to grow an image beyond its original dimensions.

faq.q: Why does the “Fit inside” option keep my aspect ratio?
faq.a: Fit inside scales the image to fit the box you entered without cropping, so the longest side touches the box and the aspect ratio is always preserved.
PNG, so you always get a lossless result at the exact pixel dimensions you chose.

tools.title: Image Cropper
tools.desc: Crop any image to a free selection or fixed ratios like 1:1, 16:9 and 4:3, entirely in your browser.
tools.intro: Useful for profile pictures, banner art and print layouts that need precise aspect ratios.

faq.q: Can I crop to a specific aspect ratio?
faq.a: Yes — choose 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:2, 21:9, 2:3 or 9:16, or set it to Free for any shape.
No. Cropping happens entirely in your browser and the download is produced locally.

tools.title: Image Editor
tools.desc: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, blur and rotation. Flip, tint or add a watermark. All local.
tools.intro: A lightweight photo retoucher that handles everyday edits without any installs or accounts.

faq.q: How do I undo my edits?
faq.a: Use the Reset button to restore the original image. Edits preview live as you move the sliders, so you can dial them back at any time.
No. Nothing changes until you download, and the original file on your device is never modified.

tools.title: Meme Generator
tools.desc: Add top and bottom captions to your own image in classic meme style with adjustable styling.
tools.intro: Make funny memes in seconds - your image and captions are rendered locally, so nothing is stored.

faq.a: It is rendered in your browser and saved as a PNG. It is never uploaded to or stored on any server.

faq.q: Can I use more than two lines of text?
faq.a: Top and bottom captions are supported, and long text wraps automatically to up to three lines per caption.

tools.title: Image Diff Checker
tools.desc: Find visual differences between two images with side-by-side, overlay or pixel-diff views.
tools.intro: Handy for designers and developers comparing design mockups, screenshots or regression tests.

faq.q: Do both images need to be the same size?
faq.a: They are scaled for an easy side-by-side comparison. The pixel-diff view compares them at their natural resolution, so identical dimensions give the most exact result.

faq.q: What does the red overlay mean?
faq.a: In the "Differences" view, pixels that differ beyond a small tolerance are highlighted in red so you can spot the changes instantly.

tools.title: Animated GIF Maker
tools.desc: Turn several images into a looping animated GIF with frame delay control, right in your browser.
tools.intro: Combine an image sequence into a shareable GIF on your own device - no uploads needed.

faq.q: How is the frame order decided?
faq.a: Frames use the order in which you add images. Remove a file and add it again to move it to the end.

faq.q: Why does my GIF look blocky?
faq.a: GIF supports only 256 colors per frame and the tool uses a fixed 480px width to keep files small. Use fewer, shorter frames for a smoother result.

tools.title: WEBP Converter
tools.desc: Convert WEBP files to PNG or JPG, or encode other formats into WEBP with quality control.
tools.intro: Modern small-format images made easy, whether you are optimising a website or working with mixed file types.

faq.q: Can I convert multiple files at once?
faq.a: Yes — drop several images and each is converted to WEBP one after another and downloaded automatically.

faq.q: Which formats can I convert to WEBP?
faq.a: Any format your browser can decode, including PNG, JPG, GIF and BMP.

tools.title: PDF Merger
tools.desc: Combine multiple PDF files into one document in the order you choose, in your browser.
tools.intro: Put receipts, scans or chapters into a single document without uploading anything.

faq.q: How is the page order decided?
faq.a: The merged PDF follows the order the files were added. Remove a file, then add it again, to move it later in the list.

faq.q: Can I merge scanning-style image PDFs?
faq.a: Yes. Pages are copied directly, so existing text and embedded images are preserved as-is.

tools.title: PDF Splitter
tools.desc: Split a PDF into single pages or extract a page range, and download pages individually or as a new PDF.
tools.intro: Extract only the pages you need and leave the rest - useful for sharing part of a document.

faq.q: How do I write page ranges?
faq.a: Use comma-separated groups such as 1-3, 5, 8-10. Leave the field empty to split the PDF into single-page files.
A ZIP archive with one PDF per group, named part-1, part-2, and so on.

tools.title: PDF Compressor
tools.desc: Reduce PDF file size by recompressing images with selectable quality. Files never leave your device.
tools.intro: Shrink PDFs before emailing or uploading them, with visible size savings computed as you adjust quality.

faq.q: Why did my PDF get bigger?
faq.a: If the source is already well compressed, re-encoding can add overhead. Lower the quality slider, or compare with the original before keeping the result.
Yes. Rasterizing turns each page into an image, so text stops being selectable — but it usually produces much smaller files.

tools.title: PDF to Images
tools.desc: Render each page of a PDF document as a high-quality PNG or JPG image. Runs fully offline.
tools.intro: Create image snapshots of any page for previews, screenshots or slides without needing a PDF reader.

faq.q: What resolution will the images be?
faq.a: The scale slider (0.5x to 3x) sets resolution relative to each page's native size; 1.6x is a good default for screen use.
PNG, JPG and WEBP. Every page is delivered in one ZIP file.

tools.title: Text to PDF
tools.desc: Turn plain text into a clean, downloadable PDF with font and size options.
tools.intro: Format reports, notes or READMEs into a clean document you can download and share.

faq.a: It is plain text with paragraphs detected from blank lines, and the first line of each paragraph is rendered in bold as an implicit heading. No Markdown or special markup is applied.
A4, Letter and A5, with adjustable font size and margins.

tools.title: Images to PDF
tools.desc: Combine multiple images (JPG, PNG, WEBP) into a single PDF — one image per page — entirely in your browser.
tools.intro: Package a photo batch or scanned pages into one PDF with a page size you choose.

faq.a: JPG and PNG embed directly. The tool will tell you if a file, such as WEBP, needs converting first.
Each image becomes its own page and is scaled to fit centered on an A4 page.

tools.title: ZIP Compressor
tools.desc: Create ZIP archives from multiple files with adjustable compression - right in the browser.
tools.intro: Bundle files into a single archive to share or store - everything happens locally.

faq.a: Store (no compression), Default and Maximum. Maximum produces the smallest archive but takes longer.
No — the archive is built in your browser and downloaded straight to your device.

tools.title: File Hash Checker
tools.desc: Verify MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 checksums of any file locally, before trusting a download.
tools.intro: Confirm a download is intact and untampered before you trust it.

faq.a: MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256.

faq.q: How do I verify a checksum?
faq.a: Paste the expected hash into the compare field and the tool reports whether it matches any of the computed values.

tools.title: File Metadata Reader
tools.desc: Inspect file names, sizes, MIME types and dates without uploading anything.
tools.intro: See what a file actually is - good for spotting wrong extensions or validating exports.

faq.a: File name, size in bytes, MIME type, last-modified date, a SHA-256 fingerprint and the directory path when a folder is dropped.
No. Metadata is read locally from the file object in your browser.

tools.title: Case Converter
tools.desc: Convert text to UPPER, lower, Title Case, camelCase, kebab-case and more with live preview.
tools.intro: Instant text casing for headlines, code identifiers and social posts.

faq.q: Can I fix text I've already typed?
faq.a: Paste your text, pick a case, and the converted result appears in the output box ready to copy or send back to the input.

faq.q: Does sentence case handle the whole block?
faq.a: Yes — it lowercases the text and capitalizes the first letter after each sentence-ending punctuation mark.

tools.title: Word & Character Counter
tools.desc: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs and reading time as you type or paste.
tools.intro: Great for essays, tweets, meta descriptions and anywhere a word limit applies.

faq.q: Do the stats update as I type?
faq.a: Yes — characters, words, sentences and paragraphs are counted live on every keystroke.
Emoji count as characters, and as words when separated by spaces — the word count uses whitespace-separated tokens.

tools.title: Text to Speech
tools.desc: Listen to any text spoken aloud with your browser speech engine, with rate and pitch controls.
tools.intro: Turn articles, notes or drafts into audio you can listen to hands-free.

faq.a: It uses your browser's built-in speech engine, so no network request or server is involved. Voice availability depends on your operating system.
Yes — rate and pitch are adjusted with sliders. The voice is your browser's default; which voices are available depends on your operating system and browser.

tools.title: Reverse Text
tools.desc: Reverse text, words, or lines and generate upside-down (flipped) Unicode characters.
tools.intro: Fun for puzzles, backwards messages and flipped Unicode for social bio tricks.

faq.a: Each letter is mapped to its Unicode rotated counterpart, which renders on modern phones and desktops.

faq.q: Can I reverse whole words or lines?
faq.a: Yes — options cover character reversal, word order and line order, plus upside-down text built from Unicode flipped characters.

tools.title: Remove Duplicate Lines
tools.desc: Deduplicate lines and sort them alphabetically or by length - instantly, offline.
tools.intro: Clean up copied lists, CSV exports and config files in one click.

faq.q: Does removing duplicates keep my order?
faq.a: Yes. The first occurrence of each line is kept in its original position unless you enable sorting.

faq.q: What if duplicate-checking should ignore spaces?
faq.a: The default case-insensitive mode trims and lower-cases each line before comparing. Turn that off to compare lines exactly as they are.

tools.title: Text Cleaner
tools.desc: Trim whitespace, collapse blank lines, replace smart quotes and clean up copied text.
tools.intro: Fix the messy leftovers of copy-pasting from emails, word processors and websites.

faq.a: Curly quotes are straightened, non-breaking spaces become regular spaces, lines are trimmed, blank lines are removed, and double spaces can be collapsed — each one is an on/off option.
Yes — straightening smart quotes and normalizing whitespace is exactly what Word-paste text needs.

tools.title: Lorem Ipsum Generator
tools.desc: Generate lorem ipsum or real-word filler in paragraphs, sentences or words.
tools.intro: Quick filler text for mockups, design comps and placeholder content.

faq.q: Can I choose the amount of text?
faq.a: Yes — set the number of paragraphs and the words per paragraph, choose lorem ipsum or random fillers, and switch the output between plain text and HTML paragraphs.

faq.q: How do I get the result?
faq.a: Copy it to the clipboard or download it as a UTF-8 .txt file.

tools.title: Markdown Editor
tools.desc: Write Markdown with a live rendered preview, then export the HTML output.
tools.intro: Draft docs or blog posts with a live preview and copy the finished HTML.

faq.a: Yes — download the preview as an HTML file or copy the rendered HTML.
Only http://, https:// and mailto: links are made clickable and opened in a new tab; anything else is rendered as plain text for your safety.

tools.title: Slug URL Generator
tools.desc: Turn any title or phrase into a clean, SEO-friendly URL slug.
tools.intro: Create clean, consistent URL slugs for CMS posts, routes and anchors.

faq.a: Accents are normalized to ASCII, then everything outside a-z, 0-9 and dashes is dropped (dashes collapse and trim).

faq.q: Can I keep short filler words?
faq.a: Toggle the "Remove short words" option to drop common stop-words (such as a, an, the) from the result.

tools.title: ASCII Art Generator
tools.desc: Convert an image into character art and copy the result as plain text.
tools.intro: Make standout terminal headers, code comments and retro art.

faq.a: Any image your browser can decode — PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF and BMP.

faq.q: Can I change the output width?
faq.a: Yes — the character width is adjustable (roughly 20–220 characters), and you can switch between three character sets for more or less detail.

tools.title: Rich Text Cleaner
tools.desc: Paste messy content from Word or web pages and get clean, formatted plain text.
tools.intro: Paste content that has formatting you do not want and get tidy plain text.

faq.q: What is removed from the pasted text?
faq.a: Formatting such as bold, italics, colors and fonts. Link text is kept so the readable words survive; the destination URLs are dropped.
Pasting styled text into a plain-text form, an email, or a database field without inheriting invisible markup.

tools.title: JSON Formatter & Validator
tools.desc: Format, minify and validate JSON with syntax highlighting and CSV export.
tools.intro: Debug APIs and configs faster with readable output, validation and CSV export.

faq.q: Does the formatter validate my JSON?
faq.a: Yes — invalid JSON is never silently reformatted. The Validate button reports the exact parse error with a line and column pointer.

faq.q: Can I convert JSON to CSV?
faq.a: Yes, when the JSON is an array of flat objects the tool offers a CSV export with a header row.

tools.title: JSON to YAML Converter
tools.desc: Convert between JSON and YAML in both directions with validation.
tools.intro: Translate configs between JSON and YAML without installing a converter.

faq.a: Mappings, sequences, scalars and basic nesting — including inline flow arrays. Advanced features such as anchors and multi-document streams are not implemented.
For supported YAML, yes. Numbers and booleans are passed through as their JSON types where safe.

tools.title: HTML Minifier
tools.desc: Minify or pretty-print HTML, preserving script and style contents.
tools.intro: Ship smaller HTML files while keeping scripts and styles intact.

faq.q: Is it safe with my scripts and styles?
faq.a: It is conservative: comments are stripped and whitespace between tags collapses, while <script> and <style> content is only re-spaced. For the smallest output, minify those with dedicated minifiers first.
Comments, blank lines, leading indentation, and the whitespace around attributes and tags.

tools.title: CSS Minifier
tools.desc: Strip comments and whitespace from CSS to shrink stylesheets for production.
tools.intro: Trim the fat from stylesheets for faster page loads.

faq.a: Comments, unnecessary whitespace, optional trailing semicolons and final-rule semicolons.
No — values such as hex colors and zero units are kept exactly as you wrote them. The minifier only removes comments and unnecessary whitespace.

tools.title: JS Minifier
tools.desc: String-aware JavaScript whitespace and comment removal. Safe for most scripts.
tools.intro: Reduce script size for production without mangling strings or string-adjacent comments.

faq.a: No — it is a lightweight strip of comments and whitespace that keeps string and template literals intact. Regex literals and other exotic syntax are not rewritten, so use a dedicated minifier such as Terser for aggressive size reduction.
Yes — only removable tokens are deleted; nothing else is rewritten.

tools.title: SQL Formatter
tools.desc: Format SQL queries with keyword capitalisation and indentation for readability.
tools.intro: Make long queries readable for debugging and code review.

faq.a: It is dialect-agnostic and capitalizes common keywords from MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite and others, indenting subqueries in parentheses. It reformats — it does not validate your SQL.
Known keywords are capitalized automatically. The “Uppercase keywords” button re-runs formatting on an uppercase copy of the statement, which also uppercases quoted strings.

tools.title: URL Encoder / Decoder
tools.desc: Percent-encode or decode URLs and query strings with strictness options.
tools.intro: Encode user input safely for links, query strings and API parameters.

faq.a: URLComponent (encodes the most, safe for query values), URL (keeps reserved characters like / and ?) and Form-style (+ for spaces), plus percent-decoding.

faq.q: Why do some characters stay unchanged?
faq.a: Reserved and unescaped characters such as letters, digits, -_.~ are intentionally not encoded.

tools.title: URL Parser
tools.desc: Break any URL into protocol, host, port, path, query params and fragment.
tools.intro: Understand exactly what a URL does - useful when debugging links or writing scrapers.

faq.a: Protocol, host, port, path, query parameters and the hash fragment — each in its own field plus a decoded-key view.

faq.q: Do I need to include https://?
faq.a: Yes — add the protocol (e.g. https://example.com) so the host and path can be split correctly.

tools.title: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
tools.desc: Encode or decode text to and from Base64 right in your browser.
tools.intro: Convert text to Base64 for API payloads, data URIs and email attachments.

faq.q: Does it handle Unicode and emoji?
faq.a: Yes — text is encoded as UTF-8 first, so characters like é and emoji are preserved after encoding.
Both — encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back into readable text. Long strings are chunked for reliability.

tools.title: JWT Decoder
tools.desc: Decode the header and payload of a JWT token locally and inspect its claims.
tools.intro: Inspect token claims and expiration without pasting secrets into a third-party site.

faq.q: Does this tool verify the signature?
faq.a: No — it only decodes the header and payload for inspection. Verification must be done with the issuer's secret or public key.

faq.q: Can I paste tokens containing dots?
faq.a: Yes, paste the full token (header.payload.signature) and the three parts are decoded separately.

tools.title: HTML Entity Encoder
tools.desc: Escape or unescape HTML entities to keep dynamic content safe in markup.
tools.intro: Safely escape dynamic content before inserting it into markup.

faq.a: The five required entities: & (amp), < (lt), > (gt), “ (quot) and ‘ (apos).

faq.q: Can I encode or decode in both directions?
faq.a: Yes — toggle between encode and decode and run either way.

tools.title: Regex Tester
tools.desc: Test regular expressions against sample text with flags, matches and groups.
tools.intro: Iterate on patterns with live matches, groups and flags.

faq.a: All JavaScript flags: g, i, m, s, u and y.

faq.q: Can I see the capture groups?
faq.a: Yes — the match log lists each match with its position and every capture group it contains.

tools.title: UUID Generator
tools.desc: Generate v4 and v7 UUIDs in bulk, with uppercase and batch options.
tools.intro: Generate unique IDs for databases, test fixtures and tracking codes.

faq.a: UUID v4 (fully random) and UUID v7 (time-ordered), which sorts naturally by creation time.

faq.q: How many can I generate at once?
faq.a: Enter a count from 1 to 100; the batch is copied as one block, or you can copy just the first one.

tools.title: Password Generator
tools.desc: Create strong random passwords and memorable passphrases with full control.
tools.intro: Create strong, diverse credentials plus easy-to-remember passphrases.

faq.a: Yes — they are generated with the browser's crypto.getRandomValues, which is the same source used by security software.
Length, the character sets included (lowercase, uppercase, numbers, symbols) and an option to exclude lookalike characters such as 1, l, I, O and 0.

tools.title: Hash Generator
tools.desc: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 hashes of text or files in-browser.
tools.intro: Verify or fingerprint strings and files with common hash algorithms.

faq.a: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512, computed with the browser's native WebCrypto API.
Yes — the digest is calculated entirely in your browser, which also means the content never leaves your device.

tools.title: QR Code Generator
tools.desc: Create scannable QR codes from links, text, WiFi credentials or vCard details, saved as a PNG.
tools.intro: Share links, text or WiFi details through a scannable code.

faq.q: Can I make a WiFi QR code?
faq.a: Yes — switch to WiFi mode and enter your SSID, key and encryption; the code includes the proper WIFI: syntax.

faq.q: How do I save my QR code?
faq.a: Press Save PNG to download a crisp, scannable black-and-white QR code image.

tools.title: Barcode Generator
tools.desc: Generate EAN-13 barcodes from any 12 or 13 digit number and download as PNG. Works fully offline.
tools.intro: Produce retail-ready EAN-13 barcodes offline for labels and packaging.

faq.a: EAN-13, the retail barcode format readable by most scanners worldwide.

faq.q: Is a check digit added automatically?
faq.a: Yes — enter the first 12 digits and the 13th check digit is computed and added for you.

tools.title: Base Converter
tools.desc: Convert between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal, with bit-length options.
tools.intro: Switch number systems for programming, networking and debugging.

faq.a: Binary (2), octal (8), decimal (10) and hexadecimal (16), plus a padded (0x00 style) binary/hex pair for byte-style values.
No — the converter works with non-negative whole numbers; fractional and negative inputs are rejected.

tools.title: Diff Checker
tools.desc: Compare two texts and highlight added, removed and changed lines.
tools.intro: Spot exactly what changed between two versions of any text.

faq.q: How are the two texts compared?
faq.a: Line by line, highlighting added, removed and changed lines with a matching algorithm that minimizes the patch.
No — lines are compared verbatim, so leading and trailing whitespace count as changes. Normalize your text first if needed.

tools.title: IP Lookup
tools.desc: Find networks, versions and CIDR details for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
tools.intro: Inspect addresses and CIDR details when configuring networks or security rules.

faq.q: Does this look up my geolocation?
faq.a: No — it is pure offline network math. For IPv4 it shows the version, class, network, broadcast, mask and host counts; for IPv6 the compressed and fully expanded forms. Geolocation would require a remote API.
An IPv4 or IPv6 address, optionally with a /prefix for CIDR.

tools.title: Server Status Checker
tools.desc: Check whether a website is online with HTTP status, redirects and response time.
tools.intro: Quickly confirm a site is live and see how fast it responds.

faq.q: Why do some sites report "blocked by browser"?
faq.a: Many servers block cross-origin requests from browsers (CORS), so the tool clearly distinguishes site-down from browser-blocked results.

faq.q: Does it use an external service?
faq.a: No — the request goes directly from your browser to the URL you provide.

tools.title: Favicon Generator
tools.desc: Create a letter or emoji favicon with a flat or rounded background in any size, and download the PNG.
tools.intro: Get a ready favicon from a letter or emoji with a flat or rounded background, and drop it into your site.

faq.a: Anything from 16px up to 512px via the size field, with one-click presets for 16, 32, 48, 64, 128, 180, 192 and 512.
A single PNG at the exact pixel size you chose — ideal for favicons or app icons.

tools.title: Username Generator
tools.desc: Generate catchy usernames from adjectives, animals and numbers for any platform.
tools.intro: Brainstorm available-sounding handles and usernames in seconds.

faq.q: Are usernames guaranteed unique within a batch?
faq.a: Yes — the generator avoids repeats inside the same batch you request.
It combines adjective + noun + optional number with separators such as dots, dashes and underscores — or an all-lowercase gamer style.

tools.title: Color Palette Generator
tools.desc: Generate harmonious 5-color palettes from any base colour, with HEX/CSV export.
tools.intro: Build harmonious colour sets for branding, design and CSS variables.

faq.a: Analogous, complementary, triadic, tetradic and monochromatic schemes are computed from your base color.

faq.q: How do I export the palette?
faq.a: Copy the HEX codes at once or download the palette as a CSS custom-properties file.

tools.title: CSS Background Patterns
tools.desc: Generate repeatable CSS background patterns with a live preview and one-click copy.
tools.intro: Add subtle patterned backgrounds with ready-to-copy CSS.

faq.q: Do the patterns work in every browser?
faq.a: They use standard CSS gradients (linear, radial, conic and repeating) which render in all modern browsers.

faq.q: How do I apply one to my site?
faq.a: Tweak the pattern, the two colors and the tile size, then copy the ready-made background CSS.

tools.title: Year Calendar
tools.desc: Generate a printable calendar for any year, as month grids or a compact full-year overview.
tools.intro: Produce a printable calendar for any year, as month grids or a compact full-year overview.

faq.a: Any year from 1900 to 2200, in two views: twelve month grids, or a compact full-year overview. It prints directly from the browser.

faq.q: Does it add holidays or week numbers?
faq.a: No — it renders the true calendar days only, highlighting today in the month view.

tools.title: Random Number Generator
tools.desc: Generate cryptographically secure random numbers in any range, with counts and sorting.
tools.intro: Draw secure random numbers for raffles, sampling and testing.

faq.a: Yes — they come from the browser's cryptographically secure generator (crypto.getRandomValues), not a predictable pseudo-random algorithm.

faq.q: Can I generate several without repeats?
faq.a: Yes — when a count is entered the tool samples distinct numbers within your range, skipping repeats.

tools.title: Event Countdown
tools.desc: Build a shareable link to a live countdown for any date and time.
tools.intro: Share a live countdown link for launch days, deadlines and events.

faq.q: Does the link keep counting down?
faq.a: Yes — the date is embedded in the link, so it recalculates the remaining time every time it is opened.

faq.q: Why does the preview keep resetting?
faq.a: The live preview starts from a default date (five days ahead) on each fresh visit. Set the field again or open the shared ?until= link to pin a specific moment.

tools.title: Percentage Calculator
tools.desc: Calculate percentages instantly: what is X% of Y, percent change, and more.
tools.intro: Solve everyday math - discounts, growth and proportions - instantly.

faq.a: What X percent of Y equals, with a summary line showing the working (for example, 10% of 250 = 25) and quick presets for common cases such as sale, tax and discount.
Results are formatted to a clean decimal with a sensible number of digits, and the summary line shows the exact math.

tools.title: BMI Calculator
tools.desc: Calculate your Body Mass Index and check which weight category it falls in.
tools.intro: Get your BMI and the weight category it maps to.

faq.a: The result is categorized as Underweight, Healthy, Overweight or Obese using the standard WHO cut-offs.
It's a screening index and does not account for muscle mass. Use it as a rough guide, not a diagnosis.

tools.title: Loan Calculator
tools.desc: Estimate monthly payments, total interest and amortisation for any loan.
tools.intro: See the real cost of borrowing before you commit.

faq.a: A fixed interest rate with equal monthly payments over the loan term — the standard amortizing-loan model.
The monthly payment, the total amount paid over the term, and the total interest included in those payments.

tools.title: Age Calculator
tools.desc: Work out your exact age in years, months and days from any date of birth.
tools.intro: Find the exact age between any two dates.

faq.a: The exact number of years, months and days between the two dates you choose, including a leap-safe algorithm.

faq.q: Can I use a different end date?
faq.a: Yes — set an end date instead of today to compute age between any two dates.

tools.title: Discount Calculator
tools.desc: Find the final price after a percentage discount and how much you save.
tools.intro: Know the final price and your savings while you shop.

faq.a: No — it works with the price and the discount percentage only. Add tax to the amount yourself if needed.
The savings amount, the final price, and the total you pay after applying the discount.

tools.title: Tip Calculator
tools.desc: Split a bill with your chosen tip percentage and see the per-person amount.
tools.intro: Split restaurant bills and tips fairly among friends.
